text:
Thank you to everyone who has shared kind words, stories, and memories of Joe. Please keep them coming—they are helping more than you know.

What is not helping, and what Joe would have been absolutely ashamed and disgusted by, are the false narratives, assumptions, and speculation that are already circulating.

I understand Joe meant a great deal to many of you, and that’s exactly why I chose to share this news. But there is a real family trying to process an unimaginable loss, and social media rumors that flow into local real life should be the last thing we have to deal with right now.

I promise that, when the time is right, the truth will come. Right now is not that time.

Until then, honor the man instead of feeding the rumor mill. Respect the family he loved and the people he leaves behind. Think before you speak. If you weren’t shoulder to shoulder with him- you likely don’t know the whole story—and it’s not your place to fill in the blanks.

Respectfully
-Alx

“The manner in which something occurs should never overshadow the end result or the legacy that is left behind. Think before you speak. Consider who will hear your words, and honor those who have yet to speak.”

text:
Father’s Day, for me, isn’t just about fathers.

It’s about the mothers who stepped into both roles when a father wasn’t there. The ones who carried the weight of two parents, often without recognition, because their children needed them to.

It’s about the sisters who stood beside their sisters in the delivery room when no one else did. The sisters, aunts, grandparents, and family members who showed up for birthdays, holidays, school events, and the everyday moments that matter when someone else chose not to.

It’s about the men who became role models for children who needed one, even when they had no obligation to do so. The coaches, uncles, mentors, family friends, and neighbors who quietly helped shape a life simply by being present.

It’s about the fathers who show up every single day—through the sleepless nights, the sacrifices, the worries, and the responsibilities. The fathers who have had to carry both parental roles when a mother was absent.

It’s also about the fathers who can’t always be physically present because they’re out working long hours, making sacrifices, and doing everything they can to provide a better life for their children.

And it’s about the young men who were forced to grow up too soon, stepping into adult responsibilities and fatherly roles long before they should have had to.

The truth is, raising children has never been a one-person job. It takes love. It takes sacrifice. It takes people showing up for each other.

It takes a whole motherfuckin’ village these days, y’all.

Happy Father’s Day to everyone who stepped up when it mattered. ❤️ #fathers #family #community #thekidswillbealright #joeandalx

One foot in front of the other, one day at a time, one problem at a time. 

Strength isn’t winning, strength is refusing to quit. 

And if I’m wrong and there isn’t light at the end of the tunnel, we die and it’s over and doesn’t matter anyways.

text:
I’ve been fishing my entire life but never like today…

I am in a traditional fishing village on the coastline of Colombia where many of the fisherman still catch their meal every day. The coastline is gorgeous, with massive rock formations in multiple different hues of grey and blue.

How “traditional” is it here? Well:

1. The guys here do not use poles, just wooden circles with thick line on it that they throw out and pull in by hand (pic 3).

2. We are in a tiny little boat with a motor that cut out about & had to be fixed when we first started (pic that they are currently working on right now (pic 6).

title: DIY Solar: Free Online Solar Design
text:
After spending months of my life designing solar systems for people I finally bit the bullet and developed FelzCalc, a free online tool you can use to build your own solar system. To use it, you will need the electrical specifications of the solar panel panels, battery, and inverter you plan to use. There is also an option to select “need one” under the inverter section and FelzCalc will provide the electrical specifications that are compatible with the battery and panels you would like to use. 
￼
Here is the link to Felz Calc:

https://felzenergy.com/configuration-page/

I also have a load calculator on my website that you can use to calculate the amount of energy and max impact that will be required for your solar system here:

https://felzenergy.com/electric-load-calculator/

I sincerely hope this tool helps all of you. Go off grid and find you’re free just like me. If you need my help in designing a system, you can book a call on my website and I will be there to assist you throughout the process.

Sending love from Costa Rica
-Joe

title: How we bought land in Costa Rica (and you can too)
text:
Given the state of America, many people are thinking of leaving, but have no clue where to start. I didn’t either when I first came to Costa Rica, but after going through the entire process, I understand how it works intimately. 

In this video, I run down all the basics. You will need to know if you would like to purchase property in Costa Rica. ￼Here are some key points:
- non-citizens have no legal rights in Costa Rica, you will need to form a corporation to buy property 
-￼ you will need a lawyer to do this, but she must be wary of lawyers in Costa Rica
- Costa Rica is a cash market, financing is not really a thing
-you must understand water rights and digital plots
- this is a Spanish-speaking country and all legal documents are in Spanish
- no license is required to buy or sell real estate so anybody can be an “real estate agent”
-things move slower here than America and it can be frustrating
-the easiest path to residency is via investment which requires $150,000 expenditure

￼ Buying property here is definitely a process, but I found it to be one of the most worthwhile things I’ve ever done for me and my family. If you would like to have my help and moving here, I am available, but it is a paid service given the lengthy process & ￼multiple moving parts. SERIOUS INQUIRIES can contact me at felzmediagroup@gmail.com.

I sincerely hope that you all can one day find your free, just like me 🇨🇷🛖💗 #joefelz #costarica #puravida #immigrants #expatlife #livingabroad #homestead #realestate #realestateinvesting #property #centralamerica #farmlife #lawyers #residency #moving #freedom #chaseyourdream #foreigner #process #questionsandanswers #findyourfreedom #expat #escape #gone

title: Could You Live in My Van?
text:

title: DIY storage solution: Joe’s Cabinet Bed
text:
I did not have room for a closet in my new Costa Rican Casita, and noticed a huge unused space under the bed where we sleep. So I decided to build a cabinet bed, which consists of these materials:
4- 75”x 8” floor runners 
7- 54”x 8” top slats 
8- 26” pieces of 1/2” metal conduit
8- 23 1/2” pieces of 3/4” conduit
Drawer consists of:
2- 66”x 4” sides
1-22” x 4” front
1- 24” 4” back
1-26 1/2” x 6” drawer face

It took me about five hours to build the whole thing and it cost less than 50 bucks total in materials .

Here in Costa Rica I only have four shirts and pairs of shorts so everything fits easily under my bed and I don’t have any wasted closet.

I wish more people would put free value out there that would help others in a real way.
Go build the life of your dreams
